changelog: Official v1.0.0 Production Release: Institutional-grade sovereign wealth operating system.
Native Google Drive & Explorer Parity: Rubber-band marquee drag selection, keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Enter, Backspace), and multi-item clipboard engine (Ctrl+X / Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V).
Persistent Selection & Floating Clipboard Bar: Full-width contextual action bar that never clips on mobile and floating bottom paste pill.
Linux AppImage & Desktop External Links Fix: External web links and download triggers now open directly in the user's default desktop browser via Electron shell.
In-App Irreversible Vault Deletion: Safe modal confirmation replacing browser prompt, ensuring reliable vault deletion on desktop AppImage, Android, and web.
Universal Multi-Attachment Hub: Sovereign AES-256 encrypted documents with split-payload lazy loading, folder organization, and direct entity linkages.
Double-Entry Ledger Integrity: 1-paisa real-time balance reactivity, custodial asset separation, and automated reconciliation.
